title.zh-CN: 持续发热与嗜睡 · 34日龄女婴

summary.zh-CN: 34日龄女婴，外院抗感染治疗后仍持续发热、精神差。
summary.en: A 34-day-old girl remains febrile and listless after antibiotics at another hospital.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别≤6月龄婴儿不明原因发热≥7天伴炎症指标升高时须评估不完全川崎病，在没有或仅有少数主要表现时也要查血并做超声心动图（AHA 2017）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise that an infant aged 6 months or younger with 7 or more days of unexplained fever and raised inflammatory markers needs evaluation for incomplete Kawasaki disease, including blood tests and an echocardiogram even with few or no principal features (AHA 2017).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 向家长追问已消退的早期黏膜表现，并按AHA 2017补充实验室标准逐项判断哪些满足、哪些不满足、哪些未检测。
learningOutcomes.en: Elicit transient early mucocutaneous signs from the parent and check each AHA 2017 supplementary laboratory criterion as met, not met or not tested.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明绝对冠脉内径会低估婴儿冠脉病变分级，在确定抗栓方案前先测身长、按体表面积计算Z值并按危险分层处理（AHA 2017/2024）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why absolute coronary diameters under-grade coronary involvement in infants, and obtain length, body surface area and Z-scores before choosing antithrombotic therapy by risk level (AHA 2017/2024).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 发病10天后确诊但发热或冠脉异常伴炎症持续时，仍给予IVIG 2 g/kg单次输注，并识别<6月龄等需强化初始治疗的高危特征（AHA 2017；AHA 2024）。
learningOutcomes.en: Give IVIG 2 g/kg as a single infusion when Kawasaki disease is diagnosed after day 10 with persisting fever or coronary changes and inflammation, and identify high-risk features such as age under 6 months that favour intensified primary therapy (AHA 2017; AHA 2024).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按年龄别参考值解读婴儿脑脊液，区分原作者的诊断与病历实际证明的内容，并将历史用药剂量与现行推荐逐项对比。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret infant CSF against age-specific reference values, separate the authors' diagnosis from what the record shows, and compare each historical dose with current recommendations.

notes.en: Adapted from a published case report (editorial revision 2026-10-28). Age, sex, course, test values, diagnosis and the report's treatment and follow-up are retained; names are pseudonyms; the hospital and calendar dates are removed and times are relative (admission = illness day 10, day 34 of life). The report's doses are recorded as historical fact, with derived mg/kg values marked as derived; the authors' diagnosis (with aseptic meningitis) is kept and discussed against age-specific reference values in the debrief. Dialogue, decisions, scoring and interventions are teaching design; data the report does not record stay unknown.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 发热10天，精神、吃奶差伴嗜睡
chiefComplaint.en: Ten days of fever with poor feeding, listlessness and drowsiness

triageNote.zh-CN: 34日龄女婴，体重4.3 kg（已称重）。发热10天，最高38.9 ℃，外院抗感染治疗5天无效，近日嗜睡、吃奶差。门诊拟“发热待查，败血症？”收入院。入院时T 37.4 ℃，HR 124次/分，RR 36次/分。家长陪同。
triageNote.en: 34-day-old girl, 4.3 kg (weighed). Ten days of fever, highest 38.9 °C, despite 5 days of anti-infective treatment at another hospital; now drowsy and feeding poorly. Admitted from clinic as “fever of unknown origin — sepsis?”. On admission T 37.4 °C, HR 124/min, RR 36/min. A parent is with her.

personality.zh-CN: 小婴儿，不会说话，病史由家长回答。家长焦急、疲惫——孩子烧了10天，在外院打了5天吊针也不见好——但配合问诊。
personality.en: A young infant who cannot speak; her parent answers the history. The parent is worried and tired — ten days of fever and five days of drips elsewhere have not helped — but cooperative.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 家长用日常口语、短句回答；说得出烧了几天、最高多少度、在外院用过哪些药，记不清的就直说记不清；不用医学术语。
speechStyle.en: The parent answers in short, everyday sentences; knows how many days of fever, the highest temperature and which drips were given elsewhere, and says so when unsure; uses no medical terms.

openingLine.zh-CN: （家长）医生，孩子烧了10天了，最高烧到38度9，一直不退。
openingLine.en: (Parent) Doctor, she's had a fever for ten days — it went up to 38.9 and it just won't settle.

fallbackUnknown.en: (Parent) I'm not sure about that, doctor.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 婴儿：嗜睡，少哭少动，不会说话。家长：抱着孩子，焦急但配合；只回答被问到的内容，不主动补充；被问到检查结果或诊断时，说这要听医生的。
actingNotes.en: Infant: drowsy, cries and moves little, cannot speak. Parent: holding the baby, anxious but cooperative; answers only what is asked and volunteers nothing more; asked about results or the diagnosis, says that is for the doctors to say.

text.zh-CN: 原报告的处理：诊断为不完全川崎病并发无菌性脑膜炎后，给予甘露醇“脱水降颅压”（剂量未记录），静脉滴注丙种球蛋白7.5 g 1次（按入院体重4.3 kg约1.7 g/kg，推算；输注时的病程日和输注时长未记录），口服阿司匹林100 mg、每日2次（约47 mg/kg/日，推算）及对症治疗。2天后体温降至正常，住院11天临床症状消失，好转出院。出院前复查：血红蛋白116 g/L，白细胞8.8×10⁹/L，血小板915×10⁹/L，C反应蛋白20.9 mg/L。整个病程未出现指（趾）端脱皮。出院带药：阿司匹林50 mg、每日2次（按入院体重约23 mg/kg/日，推算）；定期复查，嘱避免与水痘患者接触。
text.en: The report's treatment: after the diagnosis of incomplete Kawasaki disease with aseptic meningitis she received mannitol “to dehydrate and lower intracranial pressure” (dose not recorded), IV immunoglobulin 7.5 g once (about 1.7 g/kg at the admission weight of 4.3 kg, derived; the illness day and infusion time are not recorded), oral aspirin 100 mg twice daily (about 47 mg/kg/day, derived) and supportive care. She was afebrile 2 days later, her symptoms resolved during the 11-day stay and she went home improved. Pre-discharge: haemoglobin 116 g/L, white cells 8.8 ×10⁹/L, platelets 915 ×10⁹/L, CRP 20.9 mg/L. No periungual peeling at any time. Discharge medicine: aspirin 50 mg twice daily (about 23 mg/kg/day at the admission weight, derived); regular review, and advice to avoid contact with anyone who has chickenpox.

note.zh-CN: 甘露醇为原作者依据前囟张力作出的历史处理；病历未记录颅内压增高的其他证据。mg/kg为本病例推算，非原文。
note.en: Mannitol was the authors' historical choice, based on the fontanelle tension; the record shows no other evidence of raised intracranial pressure. The mg/kg values are derived for this case, not stated in the report.

text.zh-CN: 出院后2个月：体温正常，精神饮食正常；超声心动图示冠状动脉病变无明显好转；血小板652×10⁹/L；阿司匹林改为100 mg、每日2次。约半年后：生长发育正常，精神饮食好；动脉导管已关闭，右冠状动脉4.2 mm、左冠状动脉2.8 mm，内膜均欠光滑；血小板正常；继服阿司匹林100 mg、每日2次。2岁11个月：一般情况好，心肺正常，血小板正常；左冠状动脉正常，右冠状动脉3.9 mm、内膜欠光滑；阿司匹林改为100 mg、每日3次。3岁3个月：身高96 cm，体重13 kg，生长发育正常，智力好，心肺及神经系统检查正常，血常规、血小板正常；左冠状动脉正常，右冠状动脉3.4 mm、内膜欠光滑；继续随访，阿司匹林仍为100 mg、每日3次（约23 mg/kg/日，推算）。原作者记录：服用阿司匹林3年2个月未见明显不良反应。
text.en: 2 months after discharge: afebrile, feeding and alert; echocardiogram: coronary lesions not clearly improved; platelets 652 ×10⁹/L; aspirin increased to 100 mg twice daily. About 6 months later: normal growth and development, feeding well; ductus closed; right coronary artery 4.2 mm and left 2.8 mm, both with irregular intima; platelets normal; aspirin 100 mg twice daily continued. At 2 years 11 months: well, heart and lungs normal, platelets normal; left coronary artery normal, right 3.9 mm with irregular intima; aspirin changed to 100 mg three times daily. At 3 years 3 months: height 96 cm, weight 13 kg, normal growth and development, bright, normal heart, lungs and neurological examination, normal blood count and platelets; left coronary artery normal, right 3.4 mm with irregular intima; follow-up continues on aspirin 100 mg three times daily (about 23 mg/kg/day, derived). The authors record no obvious adverse effects over 3 years 2 months of aspirin.

name.zh-CN: 静脉注射免疫球蛋白（IVIG）2 g/kg，单次输注

dose.zh-CN: 口服30–50 mg/kg/日，分3次（中国2022共识；AHA为中等剂量30–50或大剂量80–100 mg/kg/日）；退热48–72小时后改为3–5 mg/kg每日1次。
dose.en: 30–50 mg/kg/day orally in 3 divided doses (Chinese 2022 consensus; AHA: moderate 30–50 or high 80–100 mg/kg/day); switch to 3–5 mg/kg once daily 48–72 hours after defervescence.

response.zh-CN: 已开具：按4.3 kg约每日130–215 mg，分3次口服。
response.en: Prescribed: about 130–215 mg a day for 4.3 kg, in 3 doses by mouth.

name.zh-CN: 测量身长，按体表面积计算冠脉Z值
name.en: Measure length and calculate coronary Z-scores from body surface area

dose.zh-CN: 测身长和体重→体表面积（如Mosteller公式），用同一套Z值公式计算各冠脉节段并在随访中沿用。
dose.en: Measure length and weight → body surface area (for example the Mosteller formula), then apply one Z-score equation to each coronary segment and keep it for follow-up.

response.zh-CN: 原报告未记录入院身长，所以本病例给不出Z值。按4.3 kg及50–58 cm的常见身长推算，体表面积约0.24–0.26 m²（Mosteller，推算）；在这样的体型下，3.0 mm和4.7 mm的冠脉内径很可能已达冠脉瘤标准。须由儿童心脏科用固定公式计算并据此分级。
response.en: The report does not record her length on admission, so this case cannot give Z-scores. For 4.3 kg and a typical length of 50–58 cm the body surface area is about 0.24–0.26 m² (Mosteller, derived); at that size, coronary diameters of 3.0 and 4.7 mm are very likely aneurysmal. Paediatric cardiology must calculate them with a fixed equation and grade accordingly.

response.zh-CN: 儿童心脏科医生：“冠脉要按Z值分级——请量身长、算体表面积，我们用同一套公式随访。她不到6个月，属高危，可以考虑在IVIG基础上强化初始治疗；抗栓方案等Z值出来再定。”
response.en: Paediatric cardiologist: “Grade the coronaries by Z-score — measure her length, work out the body surface area, and we'll use one equation throughout follow-up. She's under 6 months, so she's high-risk and intensified initial therapy alongside IVIG is worth considering; the antithrombotic plan waits for the Z-scores.”

name.zh-CN: 糖皮质激素辅助初始治疗（高危患儿，与儿童心脏科商定）

dose.zh-CN: 与IVIG同时开始；具体药物、剂量和疗程由儿童心脏科或川崎病团队确定（AHA 2024：最佳方案尚无定论）。
dose.en: Started with IVIG; drug, dose and duration set by paediatric cardiology or the Kawasaki disease team (AHA 2024: the optimal regimen is not settled).

response.zh-CN: 已与儿童心脏科商定并开始。原报告未记录使用糖皮质激素。
response.en: Agreed with paediatric cardiology and started. The report records no corticosteroid.

dose.zh-CN: 20%甘露醇0.25–1 g/kg静脉滴注，20–30分钟滴完（高渗治疗）。
dose.en: 20% mannitol 0.25–1 g/kg IV over 20–30 minutes (hyperosmolar therapy).

response.zh-CN: 已给。这是原报告的历史处理（依据前囟张力较高）。病历未记录颅内压增高的其他证据——前囟是平的；高渗治疗用于有颅内压增高或脑疝征象者，现行川崎病指南没有用甘露醇治疗无菌性脑膜炎的推荐，而渗透性利尿会让吃奶差的小婴儿更缺水。
response.en: Given. This was the report's historical choice, based on the fontanelle tension. The record shows no other evidence of raised intracranial pressure — the fontanelle was flat; hyperosmolar therapy is for signs of raised pressure or herniation, current Kawasaki disease guidance does not recommend mannitol for aseptic meningitis, and the osmotic diuresis further dries out a poorly feeding young infant.

name.zh-CN: 继续经验性静脉抗生素（等待培养结果）
name.en: Continue empirical IV antibiotics while cultures are pending

dose.zh-CN: 按本院小婴儿脓毒症方案经验性用药，培养阴性后再评估是否停用。
dose.en: Empirical treatment per the local young-infant sepsis protocol, reviewed once the cultures are negative.

response.zh-CN: 已开具。病情危重的发热小婴儿在培养报阴性前继续抗生素是合理的，但它不治疗川崎病，也不能代替IVIG。原报告未说明入院后是否继续用抗生素。
response.en: Prescribed. Continuing antibiotics until the cultures are negative is reasonable in a sick febrile young infant, but it does not treat Kawasaki disease or replace IVIG. The report does not say whether antibiotics were continued after admission.

dose.zh-CN: 布洛芬口服混悬液按体重给药。

harm.zh-CN: 她在服阿司匹林：布洛芬会拮抗阿司匹林不可逆的抗血小板作用（AHA 2017），冠脉扩张的患儿应避免同用；需要退热时用对乙酰氨基酚。
harm.en: She is on aspirin: ibuprofen antagonises aspirin's irreversible antiplatelet effect (AHA 2017) and should be avoided in a child with dilated coronary arteries; use paracetamol for fever.

response.zh-CN: 护士暂缓发药并请你复核。

name.zh-CN: 小剂量阿司匹林3–5 mg/kg，每日1次（抗血小板）

dose.zh-CN: 退热48–72小时后改为3–5 mg/kg口服每日1次；疗程和是否加用其他抗栓药按冠脉Z值危险分层决定。
dose.en: From 48–72 hours after defervescence, 3–5 mg/kg orally once daily; duration and any added antithrombotic follow the coronary Z-score risk level.

response.zh-CN: 已开具：按4.3 kg约13–22 mg每日1次，需用合适的儿童剂型。
response.en: Prescribed: about 13–22 mg once daily for 4.3 kg, in a suitable paediatric formulation.

name.zh-CN: 低分子肝素抗凝（大型或巨大冠脉瘤时）
name.en: Low-molecular-weight heparin (if a large or giant aneurysm)

dose.zh-CN: 在小剂量阿司匹林基础上加用低分子肝素（婴儿剂量，按抗Xa活性调整）或华法林（INR 2.0–3.0），适用于Z值≥10或内径≥8 mm的冠脉瘤；与儿童心脏科、血液科共同管理。
dose.en: Added to low-dose aspirin: LMWH (infant dosing, adjusted to anti-Xa activity) or warfarin (INR 2.0–3.0), for aneurysms with Z ≥10 or ≥8 mm; managed with paediatric cardiology and haematology.

response.zh-CN: 是否抗凝取决于Z值分级：本病例没有身长，无法定级，实际工作中先算Z值再决定。原报告未记录使用抗凝药。
response.en: Whether to anticoagulate depends on the Z-score grade: without her length this case cannot grade it, so in practice the Z-scores come first. The report records no anticoagulant.

name.zh-CN: 出院宣教：阿司匹林期间的防护、疫苗安排、复诊
name.en: Discharge teaching: precautions on aspirin, vaccine timing, review

dose.zh-CN: 长期服阿司匹林：接触水痘或流感、出现发热时及时就诊（瑞氏综合征风险），每年接种灭活流感疫苗，不用布洛芬；IVIG后11个月内暂缓麻疹、水痘等活疫苗；说明按时复查超声心动图的重要性。
dose.en: On long-term aspirin: seek review promptly after contact with chickenpox or influenza or with any fever (Reye syndrome risk), give inactivated influenza vaccine every year, avoid ibuprofen; defer measles and varicella vaccines for 11 months after IVIG; explain why the echocardiogram reviews matter.

response.zh-CN: 家长复述了要点。原报告的医嘱是定期复查、避免接触水痘患者。
response.en: The parent repeats the key points back. The report's advice was regular review and avoiding contact with chickenpox.

name.zh-CN: 安排超声心动图随访（按危险分层）
name.en: Arrange echocardiographic follow-up by risk level

dose.zh-CN: 高危患儿约1周内首次复查（AHA 2024），此后按冠脉危险分层安排超声心动图及其他评估。
dose.en: First review within about 1 week for a high-risk patient (AHA 2024), then echocardiography and other tests by coronary risk level.

response.zh-CN: 已预约儿童心脏科门诊和超声心动图复查。
response.en: Paediatric cardiology clinic and repeat echocardiography booked.

title.en: Take the fever history from the parent

hint.zh-CN: 烧了几天、最高多少度、在外院用过什么？刚生病时出现过、现在已经看不到的表现有哪些？
hint.en: How long, how high, and what has been tried? Which signs appeared early in the illness and may have gone by now?

guidance.zh-CN: 家长在床旁抱着孩子。问清发热经过、外院治疗、吃奶和精神，以及病初的表现。
guidance.en: The parent is holding the baby at the bedside. Ask about the fever, treatment elsewhere, feeding and alertness, and how the illness began.

hint.zh-CN: 精神反应、前囟和颈部怎样？此刻的眼睛、口唇、皮肤和颈部淋巴结又怎样？
hint.en: How alert is she, and how are the fontanelle and neck? How do the eyes, lips, skin and neck nodes look right now?

guidance.zh-CN: 检查一般情况、前囟和颈部、黏膜皮肤及心肺。
guidance.en: Check her general condition, fontanelle and neck, mucosa and skin, heart and lungs.

title.en: Investigate and put the results together

hint.zh-CN: ≤6月龄婴儿发热≥7天时，哪些化验和影像能支持或排除你考虑的诊断？脑脊液结果要和哪个年龄段的参考值比较？
hint.en: In an infant of 6 months or younger with 7 days or more of fever, which tests support or exclude what you are considering? Against which age's reference values do you read the CSF?

guidance.zh-CN: 先在会诊板决定下一步，再开检查、调阅结果并作出诊断。
guidance.en: Decide the next step on the case board, then order the tests, read the results and make the diagnosis.

hint.zh-CN: 病程已到第10天，还值得用什么？她属于哪一类风险？她的冠脉大小应该用什么尺度衡量？
hint.en: On illness day 10, what is still worth giving? Which risk group is she in? On what scale should her coronary size be judged?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上决定治疗，然后开具并给药。
guidance.en: Decide the treatment on the case board, then prescribe and give it.

hint.zh-CN: 退热后阿司匹林用多大剂量？抗栓强度由什么决定？长期服阿司匹林、刚用过IVIG，对疫苗和感染意味着什么？
hint.en: What aspirin dose after the fever settles? What decides how much antithrombotic therapy she needs? What do long-term aspirin and recent IVIG mean for vaccines and infections?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅住院经过和出院前复查，在会诊板上决定出院方案。
guidance.en: Read the inpatient course and pre-discharge tests, then decide the discharge plan on the case board.

hint.zh-CN: 对照原报告的随访：冠脉怎样变化？当年的阿司匹林剂量与现行推荐差多少？
hint.en: Compare the report's follow-up: how did the coronary arteries change, and how far were the doses then from today's advice?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅出院后的随访记录。

prompt.zh-CN: 34日龄女婴发热10天，外院抗生素5天无效；家长说病初双眼和口唇发红，现已消退；现在嗜睡，前囟张力偏高。下一步最合适的是？
prompt.en: A 34-day-old girl has had 10 days of fever despite 5 days of antibiotics elsewhere; her parent describes red eyes and lips early in the illness, now gone; she is drowsy and her fontanelle feels tense. What is the best next step?

need.zh-CN: 先向家长问清发热经过、外院治疗和病初的眼睛、嘴唇情况，并检查一般情况和前囟。
need.en: First take the fever history, treatment elsewhere and the early eye and lip changes from the parent, and check her general condition and fontanelle.

text.zh-CN: 同时按严重细菌感染和不完全川崎病评估：血常规、CRP和血沉、白蛋白、ALT、尿常规和血培养，腰椎穿刺查脑脊液及培养，并尽快做超声心动图
text.en: Evaluate for serious bacterial infection and incomplete Kawasaki disease together: blood count, CRP and ESR, albumin, ALT, urinalysis and blood culture, a lumbar puncture with CSF culture, and an echocardiogram without delay

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。AHA 2017的不完全川崎病流程：≤6月龄婴儿发热≥7天且无其他解释，即使没有主要表现也要查炎症指标，有全身炎症就做超声心动图；她还有2项已消退的主要表现（双眼、口唇）。嗜睡的发热小婴儿仍须培养和脑脊液检查——两条线并行，而不是二选一。
feedback.en: Correct. The AHA 2017 incomplete-Kawasaki algorithm: an infant of 6 months or younger on day 7 or later of unexplained fever needs inflammatory markers, and an echocardiogram if inflammation is present, even with no principal features — and she has had two transient ones (eyes, lips). A drowsy febrile young infant still needs cultures and CSF: the two evaluations run in parallel, not one instead of the other.

text.zh-CN: 先升级为更广谱的抗生素，等培养结果；川崎病至少要有4项主要表现才需要考虑
text.en: Escalate to broader-spectrum antibiotics and wait for the cultures; Kawasaki disease only needs considering with at least four principal features

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。“5项中4项”只定义完全型川崎病；小婴儿常常表现不全，却是冠脉风险最高的人群。只换抗生素不找川崎病，会白白耗掉治疗窗（AHA 2017）。
feedback.en: No. Four of five features defines complete Kawasaki disease only; young infants often have fewer features yet carry the highest coronary risk. Changing antibiotics without looking for Kawasaki disease wastes days of the treatment window (AHA 2017).

text.zh-CN: 以脑膜炎为主：先做头颅影像并用降颅压药，心脏评估以后再说
text.en: Treat this as meningitis first: brain imaging and drugs to lower intracranial pressure now, the heart later

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。前囟平、张力偏高和可疑颈抵抗需要的是腰穿和培养，而不是在没有颅内压增高证据时就降颅压；这个病威胁的是冠状动脉，超声心动图不能等。
feedback.en: No. A flat fontanelle with somewhat raised tension and equivocal neck stiffness call for a lumbar puncture and cultures, not for lowering intracranial pressure without evidence that it is raised; what this illness threatens is the coronary arteries, and the echocardiogram cannot wait.

text.zh-CN: 眼红和唇红已经消退、也没有皮疹，可以排除川崎病，继续观察
text.en: The red eyes and lips have gone and there is no rash, so Kawasaki disease is excluded: observe

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。主要表现常常一过性出现，病史中出现过就算数；今天黏膜检查正常不能抹掉病史（AHA 2017）。观察等于让一个发热、嗜睡的小婴儿得不到评估和治疗。
feedback.en: No. Principal features are often transient and count when the history reports them; a normal mucosal examination today does not erase them (AHA 2017). Observation leaves a febrile, drowsy young infant unassessed and untreated.

prompt.zh-CN: 结合病史、炎症指标、脑脊液、培养和超声心动图，哪种表述最符合证据？
prompt.en: Putting together the history, inflammatory markers, CSF, cultures and echocardiogram, which statement best fits the evidence?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅血常规及CRP、脑脊液、培养和超声心动图结果。
need.en: First read the blood count and CRP, the CSF, the cultures and the echocardiogram.

text.zh-CN: 不完全川崎病：发热≥5天伴2项主要表现、CRP明显升高、血小板增多，超声心动图示冠脉扩张（按她的体型很可能已达冠脉瘤范围）；脑脊液细胞数和蛋白都在该日龄的正常范围内，病历并未证明脑膜炎
text.en: Incomplete Kawasaki disease: fever of 5 days or more with 2 principal features, a markedly raised CRP and thrombocytosis, and coronary dilatation on the echo (very likely aneurysmal at her size); CSF cells and protein are within normal limits for her age, so the record does not demonstrate meningitis

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。按AHA 2017流程：CRP≥3.0 mg/dL之后，补充实验室标准只满足1项（第7天后血小板≥450×10⁹/L；白细胞14.9×10⁹/L略低于15，ALT正常，白蛋白和尿常规未查），因此由阳性的超声心动图决定。脑脊液蛋白0.49 g/L低于29–42日龄的第95百分位数0.89 g/L（Shah 2011），且无细胞数增多。
feedback.en: Correct. Following the AHA 2017 algorithm: with CRP of 3.0 mg/dL or more, only one supplementary criterion is met (platelets of 450 ×10⁹/L or more after day 7; white cells of 14.9 ×10⁹/L are just under 15, ALT is normal, albumin and urine were not tested), so the positive echocardiogram decides. A CSF protein of 0.49 g/L is below the 95th centile for 29–42 days (0.89 g/L; Shah 2011), and there is no pleocytosis.

text.zh-CN: 川崎病并发无菌性脑膜炎：脑脊液蛋白升高，加上嗜睡和前囟张力高，即可诊断
text.en: Kawasaki disease with aseptic meningitis: the raised CSF protein, with the drowsiness and tense fontanelle, makes the diagnosis

feedback.zh-CN: 这是原报告作者的诊断，但证据不足。0.49 g/L在34日龄属正常（29–42日龄第95百分位数0.89 g/L，Shah 2011），细胞数也正常；川崎病相关的无菌性脑膜炎通常表现为培养阴性的脑脊液细胞数增多。发热、炎症明显的小婴儿出现嗜睡，并不需要用脑膜炎来解释。
feedback.en: That was the authors' diagnosis, but the evidence does not support it. 0.49 g/L is normal at 34 days (95th centile 0.89 g/L at 29–42 days; Shah 2011) and the cell count was normal; Kawasaki-associated aseptic meningitis is ordinarily a culture-negative CSF pleocytosis. Drowsiness in a febrile, highly inflamed young infant does not need meningitis to explain it.

text.zh-CN: 培养阴性的败血症或部分治疗过的细菌性脑膜炎，延长抗生素疗程即可；不足4项主要表现就不是川崎病
text.en: Culture-negative sepsis or partly treated bacterial meningitis — extend the antibiotics; with fewer than four principal features it is not Kawasaki disease

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。采样前用过抗生素确实会降低培养阳性率，但脑脊液细胞数、糖、氯化物正常不支持细菌性脑膜炎，冠脉扩张也不是败血症能解释的；“不足4项”恰恰是不完全川崎病的情形。原作者也以无感染灶、培养阴性、抗生素无效而排除了败血症。
feedback.en: No. Antibiotics before sampling do lower culture yield, but normal CSF cells, glucose and chloride argue against bacterial meningitis, and sepsis does not explain coronary dilatation; fewer than four features is exactly the incomplete-Kawasaki situation. The authors, too, excluded sepsis: no focus, negative cultures, no response to antibiotics.

prompt.zh-CN: 诊断明确（病程第10天前后），应怎样开始治疗？
prompt.en: With the diagnosis made (around illness day 10), how should treatment start?

need.zh-CN: 先在会诊板上作出诊断。
need.en: First make the diagnosis on the case board.

text.zh-CN: 立即静脉输注IVIG 2 g/kg（单次）并口服阿司匹林；她<6月龄、诊断时已有冠脉扩张，属高危，与儿童心脏科讨论强化初始治疗（如加用糖皮质激素）；量身长、按体表面积计算冠脉Z值，抗栓方案按Z值分级确定
text.en: Give IVIG 2 g/kg as a single infusion now with oral aspirin; she is high-risk (under 6 months, coronary dilatation at diagnosis), so discuss intensified initial therapy (for example a corticosteroid) with paediatric cardiology; measure her length, express the coronary sizes as Z-scores from body surface area, and base antithrombotic therapy on the Z grade

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。AHA 2017：IVIG 2 g/kg单次输注；发病10天后若仍发热或有冠脉异常且炎症持续（CRP>3.0 mg/dL），仍应给予（Ⅱa类，证据B级）。AHA 2024：<6月龄或基线Z值≥2.5为高危，强化初始治疗可能获益。绝对内径会低估婴儿冠脉病变，大型或巨大冠脉瘤（Z≥10或≥8 mm）须在小剂量阿司匹林基础上加抗凝。
feedback.en: Correct. AHA 2017: IVIG 2 g/kg as a single infusion, still indicated after day 10 when fever or coronary abnormalities persist with ongoing inflammation (CRP >3.0 mg/dL; Class IIa, LOE B). AHA 2024: age under 6 months or a baseline Z of 2.5 or more is high-risk, and intensified initial therapy may benefit. Absolute diameters under-grade infants; a large or giant aneurysm (Z ≥10 or ≥8 mm) needs anticoagulation on top of low-dose aspirin.

text.zh-CN: 已到发病第10天，IVIG已经没用，只用阿司匹林
text.en: It is day 10 already — too late for IVIG; aspirin alone

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。AHA 2017推荐：发病10天后仍发热或有冠脉异常、且炎症持续（CRP>3.0 mg/dL）者仍应用IVIG。她两者都有（CRP>200 mg/L），不用IVIG就放弃了唯一被证明能减少冠脉瘤的治疗。
feedback.en: No. AHA 2017 recommends IVIG after day 10 for persistent fever or coronary abnormalities with ongoing inflammation (CRP >3.0 mg/dL). She has both (CRP >200 mg/L): withholding IVIG gives up the one treatment shown to reduce aneurysms.

text.zh-CN: 报告为轻度、中度扩张，常规用IVIG和阿司匹林即可，不必算Z值，出院后单用阿司匹林
text.en: The report grades the dilatation as mild and moderate: routine IVIG and aspirin, no need for Z-scores, aspirin alone after discharge

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。按毫米分级会低估婴儿的冠脉病变：4.3 kg婴儿的右冠状动脉4.7 mm很可能已是冠脉瘤。AHA 2017/2024按体表面积校正的Z值分级，这一分级决定是单用阿司匹林还是加抗凝，以及多久复查一次。
feedback.en: No. Millimetre grading under-classifies coronary disease in infants: a 4.7-mm right coronary artery in a 4.3-kg infant is very likely an aneurysm. AHA 2017/2024 grade by body-surface-area-adjusted Z-score, and that grade decides between aspirin alone and aspirin plus anticoagulation, and how often to scan.

text.zh-CN: 先继续抗生素并复查脑脊液，排除感染后再决定是否用IVIG
text.en: Continue the antibiotics and repeat the CSF first; decide about IVIG once infection is excluded

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。培养已阴性，脑脊液在该日龄正常；再等一次腰穿只会进一步推迟IVIG，而她的冠脉已经扩张。如有需要，抗生素可以同时继续，但不能代替IVIG。
feedback.en: No. The cultures are already negative and the CSF is normal for her age; waiting for another lumbar puncture only delays IVIG further while her coronary arteries are already dilated. Antibiotics can continue alongside if needed, but they do not replace IVIG.

prompt.zh-CN: 出院前（住院第11天）：已退热，血小板915×10⁹/L，CRP 20.9 mg/L，冠脉Z值尚未算出。出院方案哪项最合适？
prompt.en: Before discharge (hospital day 11): afebrile, platelets 915 ×10⁹/L, CRP 20.9 mg/L, coronary Z-scores not yet calculated. Which discharge plan is best?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅住院经过及出院记录。
need.en: First read the inpatient course and discharge record.

text.zh-CN: 改为小剂量阿司匹林3–5 mg/kg每日1次；算出Z值后按危险分层决定是否加抗凝（大型或巨大冠脉瘤加低分子肝素或华法林）并安排超声随访；每年接种灭活流感疫苗、避免布洛芬，接触水痘或流感时及时就诊；IVIG后11个月内暂缓麻疹、水痘等活疫苗
text.en: Switch to low-dose aspirin 3–5 mg/kg once daily; once the Z-scores are known, decide on anticoagulation by risk level (LMWH or warfarin for a large or giant aneurysm) and schedule echocardiograms; inactivated influenza vaccine every year, no ibuprofen, prompt review after contact with chickenpox or influenza; defer measles and varicella vaccines for 11 months after IVIG

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。AHA 2017/2024及中国2022共识：退热后改为3–5 mg/kg/日；抗栓按Z值危险分层，大型或巨大冠脉瘤在小剂量阿司匹林基础上加低分子肝素或华法林是合理的（Ⅱa类，证据B级）。长期服阿司匹林者感染流感或水痘有瑞氏综合征风险——原报告“避免接触水痘患者”的医嘱即为此；IVIG会削弱麻疹、水痘疫苗的应答。
feedback.en: Correct. AHA 2017/2024 and the Chinese 2022 consensus: 3–5 mg/kg/day once the fever has settled; thromboprophylaxis follows the Z-score risk level, and LMWH or warfarin added to low-dose aspirin is reasonable for a large or giant aneurysm (Class IIa, LOE B). Influenza or varicella on long-term aspirin carries a Reye syndrome risk — the reason for the report's advice to avoid chickenpox contacts; IVIG blunts the response to measles and varicella vaccines.

text.zh-CN: 按原报告的做法：阿司匹林50 mg每日2次（约23 mg/kg/日），一直用到冠脉恢复
text.en: As the report did: aspirin 50 mg twice daily (about 23 mg/kg/day) until the coronary arteries recover

feedback.zh-CN: 这是原报告的方案，沿用了当时“2个月后减为15–30 mg/(kg·d)”的旧做法。现行抗血小板剂量是3–5 mg/kg每日1次（AHA 2017/2024；中国2022共识）：更大的剂量增加胃肠道和瑞氏综合征风险，却不增加抗血小板作用，对需要抗凝的大型冠脉瘤也无济于事。
feedback.en: That is the report's regimen, following the older practice of 15–30 mg/kg/day after 2 months. The antiplatelet dose today is 3–5 mg/kg once daily (AHA 2017/2024; Chinese 2022 consensus): higher doses add gastrointestinal and Reye syndrome risk without more antiplatelet effect, and do nothing for a large aneurysm that needs anticoagulation.

text.zh-CN: 已退热、CRP下降，出院时停用阿司匹林，3个月后复查超声
text.en: She is afebrile and the CRP is falling: stop aspirin at discharge and repeat the echo in 3 months

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。冠脉仍在扩张，至少要继续小剂量阿司匹林，Z值分级高时还要更多；高危患儿约1周内就应复查（AHA 2024），以便及时发现正在扩大的冠脉瘤。
feedback.en: No. The coronary arteries are still dilated, so at least low-dose aspirin continues, and more if the Z grade demands it; a high-risk infant should be re-scanned within about a week (AHA 2024) to catch an expanding aneurysm.

text.zh-CN: 按常规程序接种所有疫苗，包括到期的含麻疹成分疫苗；长期服阿司匹林不需要特别防护
text.en: Vaccinate on the routine schedule, including measles-containing vaccine when due; no special precautions on long-term aspirin

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。IVIG 2 g/kg后11个月内输入的抗体会削弱麻疹、水痘疫苗的应答，应暂缓接种；长期服阿司匹林的孩子要每年接种灭活流感疫苗，并了解瑞氏综合征的风险（AHA 2017）。
feedback.en: No. For 11 months after IVIG 2 g/kg the infused antibodies blunt measles and varicella vaccine responses, so defer them; a child on long-term aspirin needs inactivated influenza vaccine every year and advice about Reye syndrome (AHA 2017).

text.zh-CN: 问清发热时长与高度、外院治疗、吃奶和精神
text.en: Fever duration and height, treatment elsewhere, feeding and alertness asked

text.zh-CN: 追问到已消退的早期眼红、唇红
text.en: The transient early red eyes and lips elicited

text.zh-CN: 检查一般情况、前囟与颈部、黏膜皮肤和心肺
text.en: General condition, fontanelle and neck, mucosa and skin, heart and lungs examined

text.zh-CN: 调阅血常规及CRP、脑脊液、培养和超声心动图
text.en: Blood count and CRP, CSF, cultures and echocardiogram read

text.zh-CN: 首次即选择并行评估感染与不完全川崎病（含超声心动图）
text.en: Parallel evaluation for infection and incomplete Kawasaki disease, including an echocardiogram, chosen first time

text.zh-CN: 首次即正确整合证据：不完全川崎病，脑脊液在年龄参考范围内
text.en: Evidence integrated correctly first time: incomplete Kawasaki disease, CSF within age norms

text.zh-CN: 给予IVIG 2 g/kg，未因“已过第10天”或按毫米分级而放弃或降级治疗
text.en: IVIG 2 g/kg given — not withheld as “past day 10” or downgraded by millimetre grading

text.zh-CN: 急性期阿司匹林，并按Z值评估冠脉（计算Z值或请儿童心脏科）
text.en: Acute-phase aspirin given and the coronaries assessed by Z-score (calculated, or paediatric cardiology involved)

text.zh-CN: 首次即选择按Z值分级的抗栓方案及疫苗、瑞氏综合征防护
text.en: Z-graded antithrombotic plan with vaccine and Reye syndrome precautions chosen first time

text.zh-CN: 与家长沟通：解释检查目的、诊断、IVIG与长期随访
text.en: Communication with the parent: tests, diagnosis, IVIG and long-term follow-up explained

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用家长听得懂的话说明：为什么考虑川崎病、腰穿和心脏超声的目的、IVIG的作用和常见反应、冠脉需要长期复查、服阿司匹林期间的注意事项；承认不确定性，回应担忧，用复述确认理解。不使用未解释的术语，不作超出病历的承诺。
judgeGuidance.en: In words the parent understands, explains why Kawasaki disease is being considered, what the lumbar puncture and echocardiogram are for, what IVIG does and its common reactions, why the coronary arteries need long-term review and what to watch for on aspirin; acknowledges uncertainty, responds to the parent's worry and checks understanding by teach-back. Uses no unexplained jargon and promises nothing beyond the record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 入院交接：34日龄女婴，体重4.3 kg（已称重），由门诊以“发热待查，败血症？”收入；外院静滴抗生素5天；家长陪护。建立静脉通路时可一并采血；腰穿由医生操作，护士协助固定体位。IVIG需输液泵，按说明书逐步调速。
knowledge.en: Admission handover: 34-day-old girl, 4.3 kg (weighed), admitted from clinic as “fever of unknown origin — sepsis?”; 5 days of IV antibiotics elsewhere; a parent is staying. Bloods can be taken when the cannula goes in; the doctor does the lumbar puncture with the nurse holding her position. IVIG runs on an infusion pump, stepped up as the product sheet directs.

knowledge.zh-CN: 冠脉按AHA 2017/2024以体表面积校正的Z值分级：<2无受累，2–<2.5仅扩张，2.5–<5小型瘤，5–<10中型瘤，≥10或≥8 mm大型/巨大瘤；抗栓方案按危险分层。<6月龄或基线Z值≥2.5为高危。没有身长就算不出Z值，不能凭绝对内径定级。
knowledge.en: Coronary arteries are graded by body-surface-area-adjusted Z-score (AHA 2017/2024): <2 no involvement, 2 to <2.5 dilation only, 2.5 to <5 small aneurysm, 5 to <10 medium, ≥10 or ≥8 mm large/giant; antithrombotic therapy follows the risk level. Age under 6 months or a baseline Z of 2.5 or more is high-risk. Without a length the Z-score cannot be calculated, and absolute diameters must not be used to grade.

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先让学员陈述证据，再追问：婴儿不完全川崎病的评估流程（AHA 2017）；补充实验室标准哪几项满足；脑脊液要和日龄参考值比较；冠脉大小为什么要换算成Z值；发病10天后IVIG的指征；原报告的历史处理（甘露醇、IVIG用量、阿司匹林剂量）与现行推荐有何不同。不替学员作答。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Let the learner state the evidence first, then ask: the infant pathway for incomplete Kawasaki disease (AHA 2017); which supplementary criteria are met; reading CSF against age norms; why coronary size must be converted to Z-scores; the indication for IVIG after day 10; and how the report's historical choices (mannitol, the IVIG amount, the aspirin doses) differ from current advice. Do not answer for the learner.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：持续发热的小婴儿
title.en: Debrief: a young infant with persistent fever

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告诊断为不完全川崎病并发无菌性脑膜炎。按现行标准，病历支持不完全川崎病伴冠脉扩张（按她的体型很可能已达冠脉瘤范围）；脑脊液细胞数、糖、氯化物正常，蛋白0.49 g/L在该日龄参考范围内，病历本身并未证明脑膜炎。她接受IVIG 7.5 g（约1.7 g/kg）和阿司匹林后2天退热；左冠状动脉在2岁11个月前恢复正常，3岁3个月时右冠状动脉仍为3.4 mm、内膜欠光滑。
conclusion.en: The report diagnosed incomplete Kawasaki disease with aseptic meningitis. By current standards the record supports incomplete Kawasaki disease with coronary dilatation (very likely aneurysmal at her size); CSF cells, glucose and chloride were normal and a protein of 0.49 g/L is within age norms, so the record itself does not demonstrate meningitis. She was afebrile 2 days after IVIG 7.5 g (about 1.7 g/kg) and aspirin; the left coronary artery was normal by 2 years 11 months, and at 3 years 3 months the right coronary artery was still 3.4 mm with irregular intima.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: ≤6月龄婴儿发热≥7天且无其他解释，即使没有主要表现也要查炎症指标、做超声心动图；她还有2项已消退的主要表现（双眼、口唇发红），入院时检查正常不能抹掉病史。
keyReasoning.en: An infant of 6 months or younger with 7 or more days of unexplained fever needs inflammatory markers and an echocardiogram even without principal features; she had two that had faded (red eyes and lips), and a normal examination on admission does not erase the history.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 补充实验室标准（AHA 2017）：CRP≥3.0 mg/dL满足；其余6项中仅血小板≥450×10⁹/L（第7天后）满足，白细胞14.9×10⁹/L略低于15，ALT正常，血红蛋白118 g/L不提示贫血，白蛋白和尿常规未检测——所以由超声心动图决定。
keyReasoning.en: Supplementary criteria (AHA 2017): CRP of 3.0 mg/dL or more is met; of the other six, only platelets of 450 ×10⁹/L or more after day 7 is met — white cells of 14.9 ×10⁹/L are just under 15, ALT is normal, a haemoglobin of 118 g/L does not suggest anaemia, and albumin and urine were not tested — so the echocardiogram decides.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 原作者依据嗜睡、前囟张力较高、颈抵抗可疑及其认为“增高”的脑脊液蛋白诊断无菌性脑膜炎；但细胞数、糖、氯化物均正常，0.49 g/L也低于29–42日龄第95百分位数0.89 g/L（Shah 2011），病历本身并未证明脑膜炎。
keyReasoning.en: The authors diagnosed aseptic meningitis from drowsiness, a tense fontanelle, equivocal neck stiffness and a CSF protein they regarded as raised. But cells, glucose and chloride were normal and 0.49 g/L is below the 95th centile for 29–42 days (0.89 g/L; Shah 2011), so the record itself does not demonstrate meningitis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 绝对内径分级会低估婴儿冠脉病变：须测身长，按同一套Z值公式计算并在随访中沿用（AHA 2024）；她体重4.3 kg，3.0 mm和4.7 mm很可能已达冠脉瘤标准，抗栓方案取决于Z值分级。
keyReasoning.en: Absolute diameters under-grade coronary disease in infants: measure the length, compute Z-scores with one equation and keep it for follow-up (AHA 2024); at 4.3 kg, diameters of 3.0 and 4.7 mm are very likely aneurysmal, and the antithrombotic plan depends on the Z grade.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 原作者的鉴别：无皮疹，排除猩红热、麻疹、渗出性多形红斑；无感染灶、血培养阴性、抗生素无效而按川崎病治疗有效，排除败血症；无结膜充血、口唇改变及冠脉损害等表现者才考虑全身型幼年特发性关节炎，故也排除。
keyReasoning.en: The authors' differential: no rash, so scarlet fever, measles and erythema multiforme were excluded; no focus, a negative blood culture, no response to antibiotics and a response to Kawasaki treatment excluded sepsis; systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis was excluded because it lacks conjunctival injection, lip changes and coronary lesions.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个历史病例：不能据此证明某种治疗的独立疗效。原报告的IVIG用量（约1.7 g/kg）、阿司匹林剂量和甘露醇是当年的做法，记录为事实，不是今天的推荐。没有身长就算不出冠脉Z值，本病例只说明“很可能达到冠脉瘤标准”，不给出具体Z值。本场景不模拟治疗反应，所有结局来自原报告。
boundaries.en: This is a single historical case: it cannot show the independent effect of any treatment. The report's IVIG amount (about 1.7 g/kg), aspirin doses and mannitol were the practice of the time, recorded as facts, not current advice. Without her length no coronary Z-score can be calculated, so the case says only that the diameters are very likely aneurysmal and gives no Z value. Treatment responses are not simulated; every outcome comes from the report.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院身长、体表面积和冠脉Z值；血沉、白蛋白和尿常规；脑脊液糖、氯化物和细胞数的具体数值及实验室参考范围。
unknowns.en: Length, body surface area and coronary Z-scores on admission; ESR, albumin and urinalysis; the CSF glucose, chloride and cell values and the laboratory's reference ranges.

unknowns.zh-CN: IVIG输注时的病程日和输注时长、甘露醇剂量、入院后是否继续抗生素、心电图心率。
unknowns.en: The illness day and duration of the IVIG infusion, the mannitol dose, whether antibiotics continued after admission, the ECG rate.

unknowns.zh-CN: 出生史、喂养方式、疫苗接种史、家族史、母亲围产期情况及病初手足改变。
unknowns.en: Birth history, feeding, immunisations, family history, maternal peripartum history and any early hand or foot changes.
The coronary outcome after 3 years 3 months.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 婴儿的不完全川崎病（AHA 2017，AHA 2024沿用）：≤6月龄、发热≥7天且无其他解释者查炎症指标，有全身炎症即做超声心动图；CRP≥3.0 mg/dL后，补充实验室标准≥3项或超声心动图阳性即应治疗。
teachingPoints.en: Incomplete Kawasaki disease in infants (AHA 2017, kept in AHA 2024): an infant of 6 months or younger with 7 or more days of unexplained fever gets inflammatory markers and, with systemic inflammation, an echocardiogram; once CRP is 3.0 mg/dL or more, three or more supplementary criteria or a positive echocardiogram mean treatment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: IVIG 2 g/kg单次输注；发病10天后若仍发热或有冠脉异常且炎症持续，仍应给予（AHA 2017，Ⅱa类，证据B级）。原报告用7.5 g（约1.7 g/kg）。
teachingPoints.en: IVIG 2 g/kg as a single infusion, still given after day 10 when fever or coronary abnormalities persist with ongoing inflammation (AHA 2017, Class IIa, LOE B). The report gave 7.5 g (about 1.7 g/kg).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 高危患儿（<6月龄或基线冠脉Z值≥2.5）强化初始治疗（IVIG联合糖皮质激素或英夫利昔单抗）可能获益，具体方案与儿童心脏科商定（AHA 2024）。
teachingPoints.en: In high-risk patients (under 6 months or a baseline coronary Z of 2.5 or more), intensified initial therapy (IVIG with a corticosteroid or infliximab) may benefit; agree the regimen with paediatric cardiology (AHA 2024).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 冠脉按体表面积校正的Z值分级（AHA 2017/2024）；抗栓按危险分层：小剂量阿司匹林3–5 mg/kg/日，大型或巨大冠脉瘤加低分子肝素或华法林（AHA 2017，Ⅱa类，证据B级；AHA 2024表2及2025年更正），Z≥5时可考虑双联抗血小板（AHA 2024）。
teachingPoints.en: Grade coronaries by body-surface-area-adjusted Z-score (AHA 2017/2024); thromboprophylaxis by risk level: low-dose aspirin 3–5 mg/kg/day, plus LMWH or warfarin for a large or giant aneurysm (AHA 2017, Class IIa, LOE B; AHA 2024 Table 2 with its 2025 corrections); dual antiplatelet therapy may be considered at Z ≥5 (AHA 2024).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 婴儿脑脊液须按日龄参考值解读（Shah 2011：29–42日龄蛋白第95百分位数0.89 g/L）；川崎病相关无菌性脑膜炎通常是脑脊液细胞数增多。IVIG本身也可引起无菌性脑膜炎（说明书所列不良反应），是另一回事。没有颅内压增高证据时不用甘露醇。
teachingPoints.en: Read infant CSF against age-specific values (Shah 2011: 95th centile for protein 0.89 g/L at 29–42 days); Kawasaki-associated aseptic meningitis is ordinarily a CSF pleocytosis. IVIG itself can cause aseptic meningitis (a labelled adverse effect), a separate matter. Mannitol has no place without evidence of raised intracranial pressure.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 阿司匹林：急性期30–50 mg/kg/日，退热48–72小时后改为3–5 mg/kg/日（中国2022共识、2023循证指南；AHA 2024）；原报告急性期约47 mg/kg/日，之后长期约23 mg/kg/日，属当年做法。长期服用者每年接种灭活流感疫苗，避免布洛芬，接触水痘或流感时及时就诊；IVIG后11个月内暂缓麻疹、水痘疫苗（AHA 2017）。
teachingPoints.en: Aspirin: 30–50 mg/kg/day in the acute phase, then 3–5 mg/kg/day from 48–72 hours after defervescence (Chinese 2022 consensus and 2023 evidence-based guideline; AHA 2024); the report used about 47 and then about 23 mg/kg/day long term, the practice of its time. On long-term aspirin: inactivated influenza vaccine every year, no ibuprofen, prompt review after contact with chickenpox or influenza; defer measles and varicella vaccines for 11 months after IVIG (AHA 2017).
